levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more check-in entries use a vague label like 'felt weird' without naming a specific physical clue.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All three check-ins name a specific physical clue tied to the signal identified.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner names which two signals were hardest to tell apart with a clear reason.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The easiest/hardest comparison is missing or restates the check-ins without identifying an overlap.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner names which two signals were hardest to distinguish and identifies the clue that helped decide.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the stress-signal reflection connects a specific clue from an actual check-in to why stress signals can be easy to miss.

lookFors: The stress check-in is treated as a real signal, not dismissed or skipped.
No check-in entry moralizes a signal, such as writing that a signal shouldn't be happening.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
